title: Multi-Skill Continual Cognition, Scientific Repair

substrate.model: Ark018GPT (10 blocks, width 384, 6 heads, vocab 8192, context 256, tied head)

C.sealed_derivable: both mappings present in every prompt; answer = g(f(x)) via context

dose_stage_b.selection_rule: smallest candidate passing both parent pilots

phase_seed_binding: each phase streams with its own order seed; b/c/d seeds bound into arm and checkpoint identity

controller_rules.replay_allocation: risk-based lowest robust-min first, deterministic id tiebreak, max 2 slots/update
controller_rules.static_rotation: deterministic round-robin over old qualified capabilities
controller_rules.predictive_trigger: robust_min < 0.95 OR degradation <= -0.03/100 over last 3 CONTROL observations
controller_rules.cap_calibration: per matched set, 16x median full-delta over 32 LOW-LR shadow steps

evaluation.battery: all qualified capabilities at every control and measure point

metrics_policy.acquisition_rule: per phase: median phase-relative confirmation of guardian arm <= 1.5 x median of PLASTIC_HIGH across matched sets
metrics_policy.prevention: capability never crosses formal failure threshold during continuation
metrics_policy.recovery: crosses threshold, returns healthy within 400 updates (sustained healthy streak)
metrics_policy.retention: sealed area (mean robust-min over measure trace) + final sealed qualification

verdict_rules.formation_gate: PLASTIC_HIGH qualifies each new skill in >= 3/4 sets else INCONCLUSIVE_FORMATION_INSTABILITY_PHASE_X
verdict_rules.interference_gate: plastic sets with >=1 old-capability CONTROL failure >= 2/4 OR static_1of32 area advantage >= 0.15 else INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_INTERFERENCE
verdict_rules.cost_slope_reported: k=1,2,3 mean replay slots and duty

durability.exact_resume_smoke: hashes model, optimizer, scaler, CPU+CUDA RNG, registry, controller, counters, phase idx/step, global step, confirmations, b_streaks, telemetry; 10 == 5 + save + reload + 5
durability.corruption_test: deliberate identity-field mutation must fail closed
durability.resume_scan_cell: read-only CAMPAIGN ROOT / VERSION / COMMIT / completed arms / active arm / phase / step / checkpoint identity / SAFE ACTION

claim_ceiling: controlled real-text-proxy evidence for a multi-capability continual-learning controller candidate; no universal law, no PRE500M/500M, no AGI or consciousness claims
